extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store. Max 45 characters.

extShortName.description: Short name used where space is tight. Max 12 characters is recommended.

extDescription.message: Switch between your own Facebook, Instagram, YouTube and TikTok accounts in one click. Everything stays on this device.
extDescription.description: Web Store / chrome://extensions description. Max 132 characters.

popupTitle.description: Title of the popup document (shown as the tab title if the popup page is opened in a tab).

list_add.message: Add the account I'm logged in to

youtube_note.message: YouTube uses Google's own multi-account feature. The extension never touches Google cookies, so Gmail and other Google services stay on their account.

foot.message: Stays on this device · Encrypted with your master password · Website passwords are never stored

chip_active.description: Small badge next to an account name

chip_relogin.description: Small badge next to an account name

used_now.description: Last-used line under an account name

used_hoursAgo.description: Last-used line under an account name

used_daysAgo.description: Last-used line under an account name

used_yesterday.description: Last-used line under an account name

used_justNow.description: Last-used line under an account name

used_updated.description: Last-used line under an account name

sub_google.description: Account detail line under the name (YouTube)

sub_googleBrand.description: Account detail line under the name (YouTube)

rename_hint.message: Only visible on this device · up to 40 characters

delete_cookie.message: The saved session is erased from this device. Your $PLATFORM$ account is not deleted.

delete_youtube.message: Only this shortcut is removed. Your Google account is untouched.

delete_stillIn.message: · You stay logged in in your tabs

add_notLoggedIn.message: No $PLATFORM$ login found. Open $SITE$, log in in that tab, then press Add again.

add_metaCookie.message: $PLATFORM$ ID ••••$TAIL$ · An encrypted session will be saved on this device

add_placeholder.message: Give it a name, e.g. Shop page

add_hint.message: A name only you see. It is used in the list.

empty_step2.message: Log in to the account yourself

empty_step3.message: Come back and press [[Add the account I'm logged in to]]

empty_note.message: Repeat for each account. To change accounts, use this extension instead of “Log out” on the site, or the saved session stops working.

error_detail.message: $PLATFORM$ no longer accepts the saved session, for example after a password change or a logout. The previous account was put back, so you can keep working.

error_fix.message: To fix it: log in to “$NAME$” again in the tab, then press [[Update session]].

lock_title.message: Enter your master password to unlock

lock_sub.message: Facebook, Instagram and TikTok sessions are encrypted. Unlock once and it stays open until you close Chrome.

wipe_title.message: Forgot your password? You will need to wipe your data

wipe_detail.message: There is no password recovery (there is no server). Every saved session and its profile details are deleted, and you add those accounts again. YouTube shortcuts stay with the names you gave them; automatic names reset. Your accounts on the sites are fine.

settings_lockDesc.message: Asks for the master password again.

settings_wipeDesc.message: Deletes every saved session and account shortcut from this device.

settings_wipeConfirmDetail.message: All saved sessions and shortcuts are deleted from this device. This cannot be undone. Your accounts on the sites are not affected.

setup_sub.message: It encrypts your Facebook, Instagram and TikTok sessions on this device. It can't be recovered, so keep it safe.

error_checkpointTitle.message: $PLATFORM$ is asking for a security check

error_checkpointDetail.message: “$NAME$” is now the account in your browser, but the site wants a security check before you can use it. Open the site and finish the check.

error_wrongTitle.message: A different account is logged in

error_wrongDetail.message: The tab is not logged in to “$NAME$”. Log in to “$NAME$” there, then press [[Update session]].

err_bad_request.message: The extension could not read that request. Close the popup and open it again.

err_forbidden.message: The extension refused that request. Reload the extension and try again.

err_internal.message: Something went wrong inside the extension. Try again.

err_store_unreadable.message: The saved data can't be read by this version, so nothing was changed. Update the extension and try again.

err_not_found.message: That account is no longer in the list. The list has been refreshed.

err_invalid_setting.message: The extension does not know that setting.

err_duplicate.message: This account is already saved. Press [[Update session]] to refresh it.

err_no_vault.message: No master password is set yet. Create one first.

err_vault_exists.message: A master password already exists. Unlock with it instead.

err_locked.message: Unlock with your master password first.

err_too_many_attempts.message: Too many wrong passwords. Wait about 30 seconds and try again.

err_too_simple.message: Avoid one repeated character or a run like 1234567890.

err_unsupported_vault.message: This data was saved by a newer version and can't be opened here. Update the extension.

err_busy.message: A change is still running for this site. Wait a moment and try again.

err_expired.message: The saved session has expired. Log in again, then press [[Update session]].

err_checkpoint.message: The site is asking for a security check. Open it and finish the check first.

err_unsaved_current.message: The account you're using now isn't saved. If you switch, you'll be logged out of it.

err_wrong_account.message: A different account is logged in. Log in to the right one, then press [[Update session]].

err_not_logged_in.message: No login found on this site. Log in in a tab, then try again.

err_no_youtube_tab.message: Open youtube.com in a tab, then try again.

err_not_signed_in.message: That Google account is not signed in on YouTube. Sign in to it in a YouTube tab, then try again.

err_invalid_session.message: The saved YouTube account data is not valid. Remove it and add the account again.

err_invalid_tab.message: The YouTube tab could not be used. Open youtube.com in a tab and try again.

err_api_error.message: YouTube did not answer. Open youtube.com in a tab and try again.

err_timeout.message: The extension didn't answer in time, so it's unclear whether that went through. The list now shows the current state. Check it before you try again.

err_timeoutStale.message: The extension didn't answer in time, so it's unclear whether that went through, and the current state couldn't be loaded either. Load it again before you do anything else.

err_timeoutPassword.message: The extension didn't answer in time. Try again.

add_here.message: Add the account on this tab
add_here.description: Main add button when the browser tab under the popup is already on the platform's site

empty_hereStep1.message: In this tab, log in to the account you want to add
empty_hereStep1.description: Empty list, shown when the browser tab under the popup is already on the platform's site

empty_hereStep2.message: Press [[Add the account on this tab]]
empty_hereStep2.description: Empty list, shown when the browser tab under the popup is already on the platform's site. The bracketed text is the button label (add_here).

add_notLoggedInHere.message: No $PLATFORM$ login found in this tab. Log in here, then press Add again.
add_notLoggedInHere.description: Add account form, when the browser tab under the popup is already on the platform's site

chip_here.description: Small badge next to an account name: the browser tab under the popup is logged in to this account

tiktok_note.message: TikTok sessions are saved on this device. Switching changes the account in all TikTok tabs in this browser profile.

tiktok_risk.message: TikTok may ask you to sign in again or complete a security check. Switching cannot prevent account restrictions.

err_no_tiktok_tab.message: Open tiktok.com in a tab, then try again.

err_tiktok_probe_unavailable.message: The current TikTok account could not be verified. Open TikTok, check the signed-in account, then try again.

err_tiktok_permission.message: Allow this extension to access TikTok in Chrome's extension settings, then try again.

err_rollback_failed.message: The previous session could not be restored. Check the signed-in account on the site before trying again.

version_label.description: Accessible name for the installed extension version.
